content.value_statement: AI coding can turn weak ideas into lasting complexity before teams evaluate value and risk. Boyue applies evidence-based boundaries to scope, ownership, delivery, and retirement decisions.
actual_capabilities: Classifies work into Explore, Select, Shape, Deliver, or Evidence and Retirement modes.
Distinguishes possible work from justified commitments using Commit, Defer, or Discard outcomes.
Reviews durable production complexity through Own, Reduce, or Reject decisions.
Scales validation effort according to reversibility and failure consequences.
Shapes delivery as the smallest coherent vertical slice worth maintaining.
limitations: Provides decision guidance and templates, but does not execute code or enforce policies.
Does not replace security review, legal review, user research, or production testing.
Requires project evidence and stakeholder judgment; it does not supply universal numeric thresholds.
May add unnecessary process when applied to small, reversible changes.

use_cases.title: Evaluate a feature request
use_cases.description: Separate interesting options from justified commitments, then record a Commit, Defer, or Discard decision.

use_cases.title: Review an architecture change
use_cases.description: Identify durable ownership surfaces, migration costs, simpler alternatives, and evidence needed before production adoption.

use_cases.title: Reduce mature system complexity
use_cases.description: Review low-value features, stale settings, dependencies, and services for maintenance, simplification, or retirement.

prompt_templates.title: Classify a proposed change
prompt_templates.prompt: Classify this change as Explore, Select, Shape, Deliver, or Evidence. Explain the lightest useful process and the next decision.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner triage for a new task

prompt_templates.title: Apply the Commitment Boundary
prompt_templates.prompt: Apply the Commitment Boundary to this feature request. State the problem, evidence, alternatives, non-goals, and recommend Commit, Defer, or Discard.

prompt_templates.title: Review long-term ownership
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this architecture proposal through the Ownership Boundary. Identify durable surfaces, maintenance obligations, simpler options, and recommend Own, Reduce, or Reject.

prompt_templates.title: Design an AI evidence plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Design an evidence plan for this uncertain AI capability. Define hypotheses, representative tests, failure criteria, costs, and a Minimum Coherent Value Slice.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced validation of an AI product capability

output_examples.input: Should we build a custom analytics export requested by one prospect?
output_examples.output: Mode: Select. Recommendation: Defer. Demand is not established. Revisit when measured usage or repeated customer requests justify the ownership cost.

output_examples.input: Should an internal workflow become a public API in the first release?
output_examples.output: Ownership decision: Reduce. Keep the workflow internal until external demand, compatibility needs, and support obligations are understood.

output_examples.input: How should we validate an AI invoice extraction prototype?
output_examples.output: Test representative invoices, record field accuracy and failure modes, measure latency and cost, and compare a deterministic alternative before committing.

best_practices: Use the fast path for small, reversible work that does not expand long-term ownership.
Record evidence, decision outcomes, and explicit revisit triggers for deferred work.
Test uncertain AI behavior with representative inputs before designing production architecture.
anti_patterns: Do not treat generated code or a successful prototype as proof of product value.
Do not add permanent APIs, settings, schemas, or services without reviewing ownership costs.
Do not impose arbitrary numeric gates when project evidence should determine the threshold.

faq.question: Does Boyue write or execute code?
faq.answer: No. It provides decision guidance, review questions, templates, and examples for AI-assisted software work.

faq.question: Should every task use every Boyue mode?
faq.answer: No. Choose the lightest useful mode, and send small reversible changes through the fast path.

faq.question: What is the Commitment Boundary?
faq.answer: It separates work that could be built from work supported by enough evidence to justify investment.

faq.question: What is the Ownership Boundary?
faq.answer: It tests whether durable production complexity is worth maintaining before it becomes a lasting obligation.

faq.question: How does Boyue handle uncertain AI capabilities?
faq.answer: It recommends disposable experiments with representative tests, failure analysis, latency, cost, context sensitivity, and non-AI comparisons.

faq.question: When should a team review retirement?
faq.answer: Review retirement when features, settings, flags, dependencies, APIs, or services deliver less value than their maintenance cost.
